notes: Fixes the curtain and shutter tiles clipping in the three-band layout. A stacked Half tile is about half a row tall, and the chrome around a control - card padding, the head's icon circle, the gap above the controls - was eating all of it, leaving the curtain's window with nothing. Compact tiles now tighten all of that, and the curtain drops its own position line (the tile head already shows it) so the window gets the space instead. The climate band gives up a little height to the control rows to match.
